productConcept.name: Bramble & Dyce
productConcept.description: Single-estate botanical letterpress studio from the Orkney Islands, producing limited-edition print specimens of native flora, 40 per edition, 4 editions per year.
productConcept.rationale: The warm bone/linen palette with editorial asymmetric grid and Cormorant Garamond + Inter pairing signals restraint, craft, and natural provenance. The dual-rhythm spacing (8px component / 40px section) and letterpress motion personality pushed the concept away from generic artisan food toward a more specific and less-expected territory: rare-edition print specimens as subscription product, grounded in place (Orkney), with botanical taxonomy as the visual language.
